race.description: Remembering Mary Olive Hargreaves Mdn Plate
race.comment: ZENDARINA (12) has just found one better in both starts to date, stepping up to 1347m quickly at Geelong and boxing on gamely for a narrow defeat. Maps for every chance from the gate and this looks very winnable. The one to beat. ZOVOZO (13) steps up in trip off a good effort at Mornington over 1200m when narrowly beaten. Turns around quickly and drawn well, this trip should suit now. ALL TOO SINGLE (6) has been solid in two runs back on synthetic, has shown ability on turf and could improve. GALACTIC GIRL (8) has been mixing form this time in, don't mind her rising in trip now from the inside gate. TRENTINO (5) resumes for his second campaign and has the ability to challenge.
